appearances.title: Tencent opens Hy4 flagship weights: 770B total, 49B active MoE, 1M context, natively multimodal, with FP8, Base and GGUF builds
appearances.summary: Weights, GitHub repo, community GGUF quants, a custom Hy License and a safety system card are all out; it follows the smaller Hy4-Flash. It is a multi-node download rather than a single-box one, and the license requires a separate agreement for hosted APIs above 50M USD revenue or 100M monthly users.
